rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issued at
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a review and the tracking or scholarly venue management system where the reviewing process took place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has content
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The textual content of a particular FRBR expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endeavour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The set of different aspects of user interests in the products of intellectual or artistic artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has confidence value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The confidence value of expertise in the review topic given by the reviewer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has sub-reviewer
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a review and agents that have contributed to the overall review as sub-reviwers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracking system
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The platform where the review process takes place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has URL
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier, in form of an HTTP Universal Resource Locator (URL), for a particular resource on the World Wide Web.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: uses identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to provide the identifier for an entity (either a funder, a person, a license or a resource).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review version
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A version of a given review, defining its content and rating, which may vary over the time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: FAIR Reviews Ontology (FR)
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Idafen Santana Pérez (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8296-8629)
María Poveda Villalón (https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3587-0367)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The FAIR Reviews Ontology (FR)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Idafen Santana Pérez, María Poveda Villalón. The FAIR Review Ontology. Revision: 2.0.0. DOI: https://doi.org/10.25504/FAIRsharing.e7e609.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resource identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to identify a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: concept scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A SKOS concept scheme can be viewed as an aggregation of one or more SKOS concepts.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identities an entity, such as a funding agency, a person or a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has rating
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a review and a given rating assigned by a reviewer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorial bibliometric data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Categorical information that characterises publication-related entities from a bibliometric point of view.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for the entity (either a funder, a person, a license or a resource).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has creator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An entity responsible for making the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: discrete reviewer confidence scale
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A discrete scale defining the confidence of a reviewer for a given topic.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identities an individual agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: literal
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reified literal.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: comment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A verbal or written remark concerning some entity. In written form, a comment is often appended to that entity and termed an annotation. Within computer programs or ontologies, comments are added to enhance human understanding, and are usually prefaced by a special syntactic symbol that ensures they are ignored during execution of the program.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: personal identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that uniquely identifies an individual person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has rating value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The value of the rating given to a review.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: discrete review rating scale
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A discrete scale defining the rating given by a reviewer for a specific scientific contribution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has reviewer confidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relation between a review and the confidence set by the author about the review topic. As the review can be written only by one author, the confidence is assumed to be for such author about the given paper without need of creating a new class involving the three actors in a n-ary alike solution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A review of others' work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is defined in ranking
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a ranking category and the ranking that defines it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to identify an entity such as a funding agency, a person or a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scholarly venue management system
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A venue management system (such as a conference management system or a journal management system) that can be used for managing scholarly venues.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: replies to
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation according to which the citing entity replies to statements, ideas or criticisms presented in the cited entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resource identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An identifier that is used to uniquely identify a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
A distinct intellectual or artistic creation.
A work is an abstract entity; there is no single material object one can point to as the work. We recognize the work through individual realizations or expressions of the work, but the work itself exists only in the commonality of content between and among the various expressions of the work. When we speak of Homer's Iliad as a work, our point of reference is not a particular recitation or text of the work, but the intellectual creation that lies behind all the various expressions of the work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issued for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a review and the entity (e.g. conference, journal) that it was issued for (usually the one that requested the review).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An agent (eg. person, group, software or physical artifact).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: released by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a review and the agent publishing it. It might be the author of the review or conference or journal to which the scientific resource was submitted to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has realization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The expression that is a realization of a work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has literal value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The value that a reified literal represents.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: personal identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to identify a person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A subclass of FRBR Work, restricted to works that are published or potentially publishable, and that contain or are referred to by bibliographic references, or entities used to define bibliographic references.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: convening organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A venue (e.g. conference, workshop), a expression collection (e.g. journal, special issue), or an individual agent (e.g. organization, researcher) collecting scientific contributions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review rating scale
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A scale defining the rating given by a reviewer for a specific scientific contribution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expression
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A subclass of FRBR Expression, restricted to expressions of `fabio:Work`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reviewer confidence scale
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A scale defining the confidence of a reviewer for a given topic.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has date modified
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Date on which the resource was changed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has date issued
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Date of formal issuance of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expression
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment:
The intellectual or artistic realization of a work in the form of alphanumeric, musical, or choreographic notation, sound, image, object, movement, etc., or any combination of such forms.
An expression is the specific intellectual or artistic form that a work takes each time it is 'realized'. Expression encompasses, for example, the specific words, sentences, paragraphs, etc. that result from the realization of a work in the form of a text, or the particular sounds, phrasing, etc. resulting from the realization of a musical work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: language
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Groups of human language variants that are or were spoken, written, or signed at some point in time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reviews
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation according to which the citing entity reviews statements, ideas or conclusions presented in the cited entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: policy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A non-empty group of permissions and/or prohibitions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: agent identifier scheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier scheme used to identify an agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reviewer confidence value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The set of values of a given confidence scale.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has language
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A language of the resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review rating concept
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The set of values of a given rating scale.
